This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

This was a real bug (reports created at the same timestamp sorted non-deterministically, causing pagination overlap/gaps), but it's already fixed: src/db/repos/reportRepo.ts now orders by `created_at DESC, id`, matching the fix described (#901) that shipped in 3.2.1. The reporter confirmed upgrading resolved it, so no further code change is needed here.
